representations.name: CRT allowed boxes
representations.new_information: Retains the exact allowed residue set {0,k+1,...,p-1} for every p in (k,2k).
representations.repairs_loss: Separates exact full-period density from the location of the first representative.
representations.first_test: Compute density and first representatives for exact small instances and compare their logarithmic scales.
representations.closure_interface: Needs a deterministic prefix discrepancy bound at H=exp(O(k/log k)).

representations.name: Covered-prefix dual
representations.new_information: Writes n_k>H as a finite interval covered by the forbidden classes 1,...,k modulo each prime.
representations.repairs_loss: Makes the fixed initial translate, rather than a random translate, the central object.
representations.first_test: Extract minimal or low-overlap subcovers for exact small k and test whether a bounded multiplicity potential exists.
representations.closure_interface: An upper bound requires a dual obstruction showing the initial interval cannot be fully covered.

representations.name: Exact pair-correlation kernel
representations.new_information: For each displacement h records the exact full-period joint survivor density J_k(h).
representations.repairs_loss: Detects clustering and repulsion hidden by the scalar density D_k.
representations.first_test: Compute J_k(h)/D_k^2 for |h|<=4k and locate zero or highly amplified modes.
representations.closure_interface: Must be upgraded from translation-average variance to the fixed prefix.

representations.name: Fourier spectrum on Z/M_kZ
representations.new_information: Expands the survivor indicator into local interval Fourier coefficients and exposes every nonzero frequency.
representations.repairs_loss: Preserves high-order cross-prime phases discarded by independence heuristics.
representations.first_test: Bound or compute low-support characters and compare their prefix contribution with H D_k.
representations.closure_interface: Needs cancellation over a fixed interval shorter than every useful full CRT period.

representations.name: Inclusion-exclusion support ledger
representations.new_information: Tracks how many primes can occur in a squarefree modulus d below the interval distribution level H.
representations.repairs_loss: Quantifies exactly why low-order sieve information misses the dense product D_k.
representations.first_test: Compare R=floor(log H/log k) with pi(2k)-pi(k) at conjectural H.
representations.closure_interface: A viable sieve must compress high-order constraints rather than enumerate their products.

representations.name: Rational interval coverage
representations.new_information: A divisor jp in [n-k,n-1] is represented by a prime in ((n-k)/j,(n-1)/j).
representations.repairs_loss: Uses the dependence of the relevant prime interval on the quotient j instead of static CRT density.
representations.first_test: Replay the June 2026 lower-bound interface and identify the first quantitative constant loss.
representations.closure_interface: A stronger approximation lemma would improve the known lower-bound exponent or constant.

representations.name: Konyagin polynomial encoding
representations.new_information: Encodes simultaneous absence of interval primes through a low-height integer polynomial relation among nearby rational approximants.
representations.repairs_loss: Couples many quotient intervals that a pointwise prime-gap estimate treats independently.
representations.first_test: Audit which degree, height and short-prime interval estimates create the factor 1/20.
representations.closure_interface: A strict improvement must lower one audited height or approximation loss without assuming an unproved prime-gap bound.

representations.name: Entropy of congruence decisions
representations.new_information: Interprets each dense forbidden residue condition as roughly one bit of information and compares total constraint entropy with log H.
representations.repairs_loss: Explains the log 4 constant in the density while exposing the need for a deterministic source of pseudorandom bits.
representations.first_test: Check the entropy prediction against exact first representatives and correlation spikes.
representations.closure_interface: Requires a rigorous min-entropy statement for consecutive integers modulo the prime family.

representations.name: Subset-product candidate generator
representations.new_information: For primes deliberately dividing n, their constraints are satisfied at residue zero; remaining constraints see multiplicative subset products.
representations.repairs_loss: Turns existence of a small representative into an explicit finite constraint-satisfaction problem.
representations.first_test: Compare candidate entropy and integer size with the number of unsatisfied prime constraints.
representations.closure_interface: Needs a generator with at least k/log k effective bits but output magnitude exp(O(k/log k)).

representations.name: Multiscale prefix blocks
representations.new_information: Partitions the initial prefix into blocks on which quotient patterns floor(n/p) are stable.
representations.repairs_loss: Keeps location information while allowing local CRT or Fourier estimates inside each block.
representations.first_test: Measure whether boundary complexity contracts across dyadic H-scales.
representations.closure_interface: A recursion must lose o(k/log k) in the exponent across all blocks.
